text: さむくなると　あちこちから　レディバが　たくさん　あつまって　よりそいあい　あたためあう。

structure.jp: あちこちから　レディバが　たくさん　あつまって
structure.en: lots of Ledyba gather from all around, and

patterns.name: 〜と (when)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb means 'whenever this happens, that follows'. さむくなると = 'when it gets cold'.

patterns.name: 〜あう
patterns.explanation: あう added to a verb means doing it to each other; ending in あい instead of あう links on to the next action in written style. よりそいあい = 'huddle up to each other, and'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て ending joins one action to the next, like 'and'. あつまって = 'gather, and'.
